integrity: Every complete strict profile through four agents is enumerated exactly. Stability and both objective values are each computed in two independent formulations; the disagreement quotient is checked under every player relabeling; and the six-agent witness is verified by exhausting all fifteen perfect matchings.
scientific_limitations: The exhaustive census is for complete strict Stable Roommates profiles through four agents. The six-agent result is an explicit sharp disjointness witness rather than a complete six-agent census.
title: Six agents are the sharp incompatibility boundary for egalitarian versus minimum-regret Stable Roommates
